newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state sells minority stake in battery firm.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state sells minority stake in battery firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state sold its stake in private sector battery firm Chloride Egypt to a strategic investor on Wednesday, corporate sources said.

They said the Holding Company for Chemical Industries sold its 38 percent stake in the battery firm for a total of 12.5 million pounds to an unidentified strategic investor. The 34,200 shares were sold at 365.5 pounds each.
An Arab investor owns 52 percent of the battery firm's equity and the American University Development Fund owns the remaining 10 percent.
